# appleads_search_term_report (Data Source)

Reads Apple Ads search-term reports so Discovery terms can be inspected before a **manual** promotion into an Exact campaign.

Does **not** create keywords or negatives. Promotion remains a Terraform config change.

Apple requires `timeZone=ORTZ` and typically omits terms with fewer than 10 impressions. Uses `POST /api/v5/reports/campaigns/{campaignId}/searchterms` or the ad-group-scoped path when `ad_group_id` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appleads_search_term_report" "discovery" {
  campaign_id = "1234567890"
  ad_group_id = "9876543210"
  start_time  = "2026-09-01"
  end_time    = "2026-09-14"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `campaign_id` (String) Campaign id (usually Discovery).
- `end_time` (String) Report end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `start_time` (String) Report start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

### Optional

- `ad_group_id` (String) When set, scope the report to this ad group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite id of the report window and scope.
- `search_terms` (Attributes List) Search term rows for the window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--search_terms))

<a id="nestedatt--search_terms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `search_terms`

Read-Only:

- `avg_cpa_amount` (String) Average CPA / CPI as a decimal string (`totalAvgCPI`).
- `avg_cpa_currency` (String) Average CPA currency.
- `avg_cpt_amount` (String) Average CPT as a decimal string.
- `avg_cpt_currency` (String) Average CPT currency.
- `conversion_rate` (Number) Conversion rate.
- `impressions` (Number) Impressions in the report window.
- `installs` (Number) Total installs (tap + view) in the report window.
- `keyword_id` (String) Matched targeting keyword id, when present.
- `keyword_text` (String) Matched targeting keyword text, when present.
- `local_spend_amount` (String) Spend as a decimal string.
- `local_spend_currency` (String) Spend currency.
- `match_type` (String) Match type of the matched keyword, when present.
- `search_term_text` (String) Query Apple matched.
- `taps` (Number) Taps in the report window.
- `ttr` (Number) Tap-through rate.
